forecast-limerick.xml: a trimmed copy of a real Met Eireann forecast for Limerick, fetched 3 Nov 2026.
warnings-sample.json: keeps the field layout of the real warnings feed. The feed was empty when the fixtures were saved on 3 Nov, so entry 1 is the real fog warning as read on 2 Nov 2026, and entry 2 is hand-made to cover a wind warning and an unsafe description.
